author: Espinosa & Ortea, 2000

note.en: A tiny polished snail, only a few millimetres long, that lives among sand and rubble and is hardly ever seen without a hand lens. Known here from 2 museum specimen records (Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2001).
note.es: Un caracol diminuto y pulido, de pocos milímetros, que vive entre arena y escombro coralino y casi nunca se ve sin una lupa. Conocido aquí por 2 registros de ejemplares de museo (Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 a 2001).

evidence: GBIF: 2 specimen records in the region (Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2001)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Specimens at Punta Mona and Manzanillo.
